title: ftps source
description: Polls a directory of an FTPS server and produces a message for every file. The body is the content; the header file.name is the file path below the directory. Once the flow has processed a file it is deleted or moved to the folder move; if processing failed, it is moved to moveFailed. A failed poll, such as a server that is down, is logged and tried again.

path.title: Address
path.description: From the URI: ftps:[//][user@]host[:port]/directory. The directory is below the login directory; after a double slash (host//dir) it is absolute

userName.title: User name
userName.description: User to log in as; anonymous if empty

disconnect.title: Disconnect
disconnect.description: Close the connection after each use; false keeps it open between uses, until it is idle for 30 seconds

passiveMode.title: Passive mode
passiveMode.description: Passive mode is the only one supported; false is rejected

socketTimeout.title: Timeout
socketTimeout.description: Milliseconds to connect and log in; also for a stalled transfer

recursive.title: Recursive
recursive.description: Also look in subdirectories, except those starting with a dot and the folders move and moveFailed

fileName.title: File name
fileName.description: Only the file with this name; not with include or exclude

include.title: Include
include.description: Regular expression the file name must match; "" for any

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: Regular expression the file name must not match; "" for none

binary.title: Binary
binary.description: Keep the content as bytes instead of text

charset.title: Charset
charset.description: Charset of the files: UTF-8, ISO-8859-1 or US-ASCII

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Order of the files; by name if empty

stopIfNoFileFound.title: Stop if no file
stopIfNoFileFound.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect

maxMessagesPerPoll.title: Files per poll
maxMessagesPerPoll.description: Most files consumed per poll; 0 or -1 for no limit

delete.title: Delete
delete.description: Delete the file once it is consumed, instead of moving it

move.title: Move to
move.description: Folder a consumed file is moved to, below the directory (or absolute); required if not deleting

moveFailed.title: Move failed to
moveFailed.description: Folder a file is moved to if the flow fails to process it; "" leaves it, to be consumed again

autoCreate.title: Auto create
autoCreate.description: Create the directory if it does not exist

readLock.title: Read lock
readLock.description: changed: only take a file that has not changed since the last poll

implicit.title: Implicit FTPS
implicit.description: true: TLS from the first byte, on port 990 unless the address has a port; false: the client asks for TLS with AUTH TLS (explicit FTPS)

trustStoreFile.title: Trust store
trustStoreFile.description: PKCS#12 keystore with the certificates to trust; "" trusts the system's roots

trustStorePassword.title: Trust store password
trustStorePassword.description: Trust store password; env DIF_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD (or its _FILE companion)
